newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swap - Gas oil steady at higher level.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swap - Gas oil steady at higher level.

text.p: Singapore gas oil swaps were steady late afternoon on Thursday after putting on about 30 cents in active early day trading following fresh physical buying interest, traders said.
"Gas oil is steady right now, people are waiting to see how the action shapes up in the physical market later today," one trader said.
August swaps were indicated at $21.60/$21.70 per barrel, up from Tuesday's $21.35/$21.45. August traded earlier in the day at $21.70, $21.65 and $21.60 per barrel, brokers said.
Firmer swaps prices was also put down to trading firms and banks who were playing the East-West spread by buying the East and selling the West, they said.
But the main strength was derived from the physical market where buying interest emerged for the first time in over two weeks, traders said,
On Wednesday, a 150,000-barrel cargo traded on Wednesday at $20.60 per barrel, free-on-board Singapore, up 80 cents from the lowest offered level last week.
The optimism was also backed up slightly by the drawdown in weekly middle distillate stocks.
The Singapore Trade Development Board said middle distillate stocks for the week ending July 16 were down 849,000 barrels to 10.615 million barrels.
But traders said 10 million barrels is still high compared to the usually levels of around 8 million barrels.
Jet fuel swaps also edged up on renewed buying interest with a 100,000 barrel cargo traded at $23.50, well above the $22.10 last trade done on July 9.

The regrade is firm even though outright gas oil swaps values have also risen sharply. August regrade traded earlier in the day at $1.85 per barrel compared to an early week deal at $1.60, brokers said.
But the deal was down about 10 cents from Wednesday's traded level which brokers said was done when gas oil was at a low level.
August regrade was last quoted notionally at $1.80/$2.00 per barrel, they said.
Fuel oil swaps were steady with August and September last quoted unchanged at $97.75/$98.50.
